widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var m = state.m; var v = state.v; var denom = Math.sqrt(v); var step = 0; if (denom !== 0) { step = m / denom; } var yMax = 7; var baseY = h - 64; var topY = 54; var avail = baseY - topY; var vals = [m, denom, step]; var names = ["m", "sqrt(v)", "step"]; var cols = ["#1f4b99", "#8a8175", "#c4512c"]; var i = 0; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "16px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic"; ctx.fillText("Adam bounded step", 16, 24); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#5c564c"; ctx.fillText("m over sqrt(v)", 16, 42); var bw = 110; for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) { var x = 70 + i * 175; var val = vals[i]; var bh = val / yMax * avail; var clipped = false; if (bh > avail) { bh = avail; clipped = true; } ctx.fillStyle = "#e4d6c4"; ctx.fillRect(x, topY, bw, avail); ctx.fillStyle = cols[i]; ctx.fillRect(x, baseY - bh, bw, bh); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.strokeRect(x, topY, bw, avail); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText(names[i], x + 4, baseY + 20); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; var rv = Math.round(val * 100) / 100; ctx.fillText("" + rv, x + 4, baseY - bh - 8); if (clipped) { ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillText("clipped", x + 4, topY + 14); } } ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(30, baseY); ctx.lineTo(w - 30, baseY); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; var rs = Math.round(step * 100) / 100; var rd = Math.round(denom * 100) / 100; ctx.fillText("denom " + rd + "  step " + rs, 70, h - 16); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#5c564c"; if (v > 2.5) { ctx.fillText("narrow valley: v large but step held by sqrt", 340, h - 16); } else { ctx.fillText("raise v: denom grows as sqrt", 340, h - 16); } }
